description: Ukrainian writer Nikolay Gogol is often miscategorized as a "Great Russian Writer." Many readers
are unaware that Gogol was Ukrainian and that he aimed to promote the idea of an independent
Ukrainian nation. This course will critically examine the Russocentric view of Gogol and
Russophone literature (literature written in Russian by non-Russian writers) by placing Gogol in
the space of empire, between Russia and Ukraine. No knowledge of Russian or previous background
required. Offered periodically during fall semester.
fullname: Nikolay Gogol: Between Russia and Ukraine (Taught in English)
